scope: A source-checked inventory, not a claim that every programme has executable or identified kinetics. Six HOG SBML variants and the immutable Jalihal PKA/Snf1/TOR source are executable references. Jalihal execution requires an explicitly audited in-memory export adapter and source-native normalized inputs/time, not physical g/L or second calibration. The actual Zheng MATLAB supplement, Pincus Text S1, and Goulev primary equations/supplement are locally pinned. Source fits, priors, observations and refused quantities remain distinct; numerical agreement is not independent biological validation. The four programmes without an executable source model were searched again on 2026-09-09 against the complete BioModels S. cerevisiae taxonomy listing, the complete JWS Online catalogue, GitHub code search and Europe PMC; no executable S. cerevisiae kinetic model exists for oxidative Yap1 signalling, the Hac1 UPR, intracellular pH or the Hsf1-Hsp70 loop, and each programme now records what was searched. Ke 2013 (ion regulation, complete printed ODE system) and Krakowiak 2018 (the Hsf1-Hsp70 MATLAB supplement) are newly pinned as equations and source code, not as shared-engine models.

carbon_pka_snf1.scope: PKA and Snf1 are both represented in the available Jalihal nutrient-signalling model; its normalized effective weights are not measured microscopic kinetic constants.
blockers: Jalihal's locally executable normalized source has an explicit export adapter; the XML declares seconds but the upstream simulation code uses minutes, so physical elapsed-time calibration is unresolved.
No validated mapping from glucose concentration to the model's normalized Carbon/ATP inputs, or from normalized states to absolute kinase activity, is available in this work package.

The 128-parameter nutrient model has an explicitly reported ensemble of acceptable fits; parameter/sloppy directions must not be replaced by a single identified point. The deposited SBML matches the older 2018 text-model directory, not every later source variant.

Units for the normalized weights w_pka_camp and w_mig_snf are unobtainable, not merely unrecorded: the pinned SBML declares a units attribute on 0 of its 128 parameters and defines 0 unitDefinition elements, upstream parameters.txt is two columns of name and value, and the primary text never names either identifier. Deriving units by dimensional analysis of the normalized network would be an inference, not a source declaration, so units_status stays unspecified_in_source.

nitrogen_tor.scope: Jalihal integrates TORC1 with PKA/Snf1; Kuepfer supplies mechanistically alternative TOR/PP2A signalling models.
blockers: Jalihal TORC1/EGO/Sch9 is locally executable only in its normalized source context; it is not a calibrated physical nitrogen model.

Physical nitrogen quality/concentration mapping to the separate Glutamine_ext, NH4 and Proline inputs, absolute TOR assay scale, source minute/second consistency and independent nitrogen-shift kinetics are unresolved.
Kuepfer model identity and scope were checked in the indexed abstract only; parameter tables and executable assets were not checked.

w_sch9_torc carries no unit for the same checked reason as the PKA/Snf1 weights: 0 of the pinned SBML's 128 parameters carry a units attribute, the file defines no unitDefinition, and the primary text never names the identifier. This is a source absence, not a transcription omission, and it is not closable by dimensional inference.

oxidative_yap1.scope: Goulev supplies Yap1-dependent antioxidant feedback models and step/ramp experiments. Selvaggio supplies peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin chemistry, not a complete Yap1 transcription model, and its yeast section supplies a second estimate of the same H2O2 entry coefficient that is 570 times Goulev's.
blockers: No locally pinned executable source model for oxidative signalling is available here.

Goulev alpha=1/min is chosen from localization timing, not a direct membrane-permeability measurement; antioxidant message stability is also a model choice constrained by response and literature order of magnitude.
The repository's Branco/Selvaggio culture-clearance transcription has not been rechecked against the supplementary equation in this work package; no measured clearance constant is promoted from it.
Bolus/perfusion entry, active scavenger abundance, intracellular/extracellular gradients and density-dependent clearance are not jointly identified.
Searched again on 2026-09-09 across BioModels, JWS Online, GitHub and Europe PMC: no executable S. cerevisiae oxidative-signalling model exists to pin. See executable_model_search.

The H2O2 entry coefficient is unidentified across sources: Goulev asserts alpha = 1 min^-1 from localization timing, Selvaggio derives 9.5 s^-1, i.e. 570 min^-1, by attributing all culture-level clearance to permeation. Neither is a direct permeability measurement, and this work package does not choose between them.

goulev2017.title: Nonlinear feedback drives homeostatic plasticity in H2O2 stress response

verification.locator: Methods s4-13, MathML equ6/equ7/equ8, linear/nonlinear assumptions s4-13-2/s4-13-6, parameter tables tblu3/tblu4; Supplementary file 1
verification.finding: Primary XML and the exact API-declared Supplementary file 1 are pinned. The supplement is a strain/genotype DOCX, not executable kinetics. The actual ODEs are dH/dt=epsilon+alpha*(I-H)-beta*A*f(H), dAmRNA/dt=gamma*g(H)-mu*AmRNA, dA/dt=gamma_prime*AmRNA-mu_prime*A. Linear f=1,g=H and nonlinear f=H/(H+W),g=H/(H+K) are distinct source structures. Alpha=1/min is an order-of-magnitude timing choice; message half-life 40 min was selected for agreement and literature order of magnitude. Protein loss is source growth dilution. The nonlinear table prints epsilon=0.06 mM/min, K=W=0.01 mM and fitted/derived gains. Apparent gain units and antioxidant abundance scales are not silently converted to intrinsic measured rates; no invented source implementation or biological validation is claimed.

pincus2010.title: BiP binding to the ER-stress sensor Ire1 tunes the homeostatic behavior of the unfolded protein response

verification.locator: Text S1, sections 1-4.2, downloaded from the exact PLOS article supplementary link; primary flow-cytometry Methods
verification.finding: The actual 119164-byte Text S1 PDF is locally pinned and its equations and parameter explanations were inspected. It uses molecule counts (not molar concentrations), seconds in the rate tables, BiP/client folding, Ero1/DTT disulfide competition, Ire1 states, HAC1 splicing and reporter dynamics. Splicing is beta_Hs*min(I1A,H1um); cooperative deactivation is gamma_I1A*I0^n/(I0^n+I1A^n) with fitted n=4.5,I0=45 and broad sensitivity ranges, not identified microscopic kinetics. In the PDF text extraction, section 4's BiP equation appears to repeat a U.B release term and its Bm brackets differ from section 3.3; visual/source-author reconciliation is still required. These source/extraction ambiguities are retained, not repaired into invented kinetics. Seven crucial parameters were fitted to dose-response data, with other quantities assumed or literature-derived. No original executable MATLAB file is supplied by Text S1. Reporter FITC-A measurements are not absolute Hac1 concentration.

unit_audit.input_convention: Declare each of the five model-native 0-1 inputs explicitly. No automatic Carbon-to-ATP coupling or conversion from glucose/nitrogen g/L. Glutamine_ext, NH4 and Proline are distinct normalized source inputs, not a single physical nitrogen concentration.

numerical_audit.scope: source-native arithmetic and numerical implementation checks only; no independent real validation
numerical_audit.strict_loader: ystwin.mech.kinetic_sbml.KineticModel via the explicitly identified in-memory export adapter
numerical_audit.independent_solver: RoadRunner 2.10.0 on the original unmodified SBML, using its unit-product convention
numerical_audit.rate_checks: All 25 derivatives against the matching upstream text ODEs and all 25 rates/derivatives against raw-source RoadRunner at 17 states, including nested-min branches and ties; rtol=atol=3e-13.
numerical_audit.trajectory_checks: All 25 states at 121 points from 0 to 60 native numeric units for source-default, glutamine-rich, carbon-absent, ammonium and proline input cases; rtol=3e-6, atol=1e-7 comparison threshold.
numerical_audit.sensitivity_caveat: Rich-input late-time oscillations amplify integration error. BDF rtol=1e-8 versus RoadRunner rtol=1e-10 initially differed by about 0.00156 at the 60-unit horizon. Tolerance refinement and independent Radau/DOP853 checks resolved this numerical discrepancy; longer horizons or other inputs require their own convergence audit. No default BDF accuracy or physical-time extrapolation is certified.

jalihal2021.gap: Executable only as a conditional normalized source reference. Unit-product stoichiometry is supplied from the checked upstream ODE/exporter, not an SBML L3 default. Seconds versus minutes, physical nutrient-to-input mapping, absolute kinase/state assays, fitted ensemble and repository software-license scope remain unresolved. Source replay and solver agreement are not independent biological validation.

garcia_salcedo2014.gap: Primary small-model equations/parameters and executable artifacts have not been checked.

kuepfer2007.gap: TOR ensemble scope verified in abstract only; retrieve primary model files and fitted-parameter ensemble.

goulev2017.gap: Primary linear/nonlinear model tables checked; no local source implementation or dose/assay transfer validation.

selvaggio2018.gap: Peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin model does not supply the full Yap1 programme: it has no Yap1, no transcription and no reporter. The yeast section of the supplement has now been read and two of its values are recorded, but the supplement is not vendored (CC BY-NC-ND, and its retrieval endpoint rebuilds its archive on each request) and the Prx/Trx equations were not transcribed into an executable model.

zheng2016.runtime: MATLAB source; Octave-compatible function tests are separate from a MATLAB reproduction
zheng2016.gap: Seven-file original MATLAB supplement is locally SHA-256 verified, not a shared-engine SBML model. Absolute abundance, temperature-entry calibration, original MATLAB runtime reproduction and source equation ambiguities remain unresolved.

pincus2010.gap: Actual Text S1 is locally pinned and audited. Printed count/rate-unit and equation-term ambiguities require reconciliation; no original executable source file or physical dose-entry map is supplied.

gabba2020.gap: Permeation model and fitted permeability table do not identify anion export or full pH regulation.

petrezselyova2016.gap: Fitted Crz1/ENA1 ODEs use an empirical forcing spline; no checked executable or dimensionally reconciled parameter set is present.

ke2013.gap: A complete printed ODE system, parameter tables with units and initial conditions for a S. cerevisiae H+/K+/Na+ model, with no executable artifact anywhere in the article. The proton balance is written on free protons and contains no cytosolic buffering term, so this source cannot supply a buffering capacity. Text S1 flux equations are typeset as images and are not text-extractable, the Hog1/Pbs2 and calcineurin/Crz1 modules were not checked against the HOG reference, and the 'Taken from' literature rows were not traced to their own primary sources.

krakowiak2018.runtime: MATLAB source functions and driver scripts; no MATLAB or Octave run was performed here
krakowiak2018.gap: Source-only for the shared SBML loader, like zheng2016, and not an independent second model: the pinned feedback function is byte-identical to Zheng's titration_YFP_FB.m. Its own contribution is the no-feedback variant, a five-fold lower transcription gain with no stated reason, and a restatement of Zheng's asserted temperature-to-unfolded-protein loads, whose form Zheng's Methods state but whose coefficients neither paper prints. Absolute abundance, assay gain and growth dilution remain unresolved.

shared_assumptions: Source SBML equations, initial conditions, model-native units and explicit dilution terms are reused, not fitted learner coefficients. Sharing a kinetic executor or physical unit conversion does not establish independent biology.
The HOG reference conditions on the source empirical OD/cell-number forcing. It is not a whole-cell growth model, a pH model, a PKA/TOR model or a product predictor.

Salt concentration to osmotic-particle input uses the source 2-times-NaCl convention and its five-second ramp. Repeated histories extend this forcing convention as an explicit counterfactual, not a measurement.
Reference structural ablations and assay/noise choices are declared prior interventions. Their values are not estimated from learner checkpoints, product outcomes or held-out native responses.

Biological coefficients and assay gain/background/noise are separate. Arbitrary or missing source units remain arbitrary or missing; no gDW, molecule-count or fluorescence conversion is silently supplied.

No parameter covariance, null direction, sensor calibration or biological independence is inferred from a successful numerical replay. Unresolved quantities remain visible and refused for physical promotion.

A local content freeze precedes reference generation and scoring in this invocation. It cannot certify historical product blindness, external preregistration or an OS-level secret from a caller allowed to read truth.
Synthetic recovery and real native fit replay have separate entry points and result labels. No success on generated trajectories is counted as real-world validation.

Two papers reporting the same number are not two sources. Before a second source is counted, its released file is hashed against the first: Krakowiak 2018 Source code 1 and Zheng 2016 titration_YFP_FB.m are the same bytes.

A registry search that returns nothing is recorded with what was searched, so the absence is falsifiable and is not repeated. A model from another organism does not become native by being the only executable one available.

No per-parameter interval exists in any pinned source, so 31 of 33 parameters carry no numeric uncertainty and that absence is the finding, not a gap to be filled later. Zheng Table 1/2, Krakowiak's two Methods tables, Goulev tblu3/tblu4 and Ke Tables S2, S4 and S5 print value and unit columns with no uncertainty column; Zheng's accepted parameter ranges exist only as a figure supplement with no numeric endpoints; Ke Table S6 is a Latin-hypercube partial-rank-correlation screen, not an interval; the van Hoek and PaxDb tables carry no SD or SEM column. Three tempting closures are refused as manufactured measurements: propagating Selvaggio's k_cells = (1.33 +/- 0.08)e-3 s^-1 onto k_inf = 9.5 s^-1, since the spread belongs to the parent quantity and the source does not state whether it is an SD, an SE or a CI; relabelling Ke's sensitivity screen as a range; and reading endpoints off a figure. Each stays in the uncertainty explanation text, where it is visible without being promoted to a number.

Every parameter cites a registered source, but four identities are materially weaker than the rest and are recorded here rather than repaired in JSON. repository_refusals is five mutable in-repo paths with no content hash and no commit; pinning a SHA-256 of a live source file would break the inventory on the next edit of that file, so the correct close is citing a revision once the work is committed, not a JSON edit. paxdb_local pins local bytes but its upstream identity is a 'latest' URL whose SOURCE.md records only a truncated digest, so the upstream release is not resolvable retrospectively even though the row is `measured` against the pinned copy. The two selvaggio2018 locators point into a supplement deliberately not vendored under CC BY-NC-ND and not deterministically re-fetchable, so its member digest lives in the verification finding rather than a pinned artifact. christiano2014 resolves by DOI, PMID and PMCID but its full text 404s and no local table exists, which is consistent with its refused status.
